1.helpText:
When you torment a person, you place it among your permanent cards. It stays there and can't be used for anything, until Changeling is destroyed. Then you return all tormented cards to your discard pile. While tormented, the persons can, however, be purged as permanent cards, and their fame is still counted.

Tormented persons still have their production, but cannot use the production. Their effects are not active and cannot be used. Since they are permanent, they are not considered to be in play.
